About me

Hi, I'm Elise.

I've spent seven years in solution engineering and enablement, first at Oracle and now at Conga, working with customers in Manufacturing, Financial Services, High Tech and Healthcare & Life Sciences. Today I build the training and demo programs that help Conga's solution engineers explain the product clearly.

What I care about most is clarity: helping people understand a product well enough to explain it themselves.

Where I do my best work: In person, with a room full of people: a customer on-site, a workshop, a training session. I enjoy complex problems where the answer isn't obvious and I have to go find it, and I like teaching what I learn so others can use it.

Why Microsoft?

Why Microsoft?

Microsoft has been part of my story for a long time. I’ve used its tools for more than two decades to express ideas, tell stories, and solve problems, starting with a project from 2003 that featured a cheetah. And, if you’re wondering, cheetahs can run up to 70 mph.

That early creative connection grew into a professional one. Today, I rely on Microsoft’s business applications to communicate, connect with people, and support the work of selling. I’ve seen how much thoughtful technology can help people do, and I’m drawn to Microsoft’s ability to turn ambitious engineering into products people use every day.

The timing makes this especially exciting. AI is changing how people work, and Microsoft is building it into the tools and workflows people already rely on, with a focus on scale, responsibility, and real-world usefulness. I’d love to bring my creative technologist perspective to that work by exploring what’s possible, making complex ideas approachable, and shaping AI experiences that help people solve meaningful problems.

Why now?

Why now?

I hadn’t set out to pursue this opportunity, but a former colleague, now a friend, recommended me for the role. I took that as a meaningful vote of confidence and a reason to consider something I might not have pursued before.

I’ve been with my current company for four years, and I’m proud of what I’ve learned and contributed there. At this point, I’m ready for a new challenge: a broader ecosystem, a faster pace of innovation, and the chance to grow alongside people working on complex, meaningful problems.

The timing feels right because I’m ready to bring what I’ve learned into a new environment, keep stretching my abilities, and contribute to work that excites me. This opportunity brings those things together, and I’m genuinely excited to explore it.

Projects and accomplishments

Selected work

One deep dive and six areas of work since 2023.

Case study · Dec 2023 onward · Conga Contract Intelligence

Proving AI accuracy on real contracts: the Prudential POC

The goal was to build a proof-of-concept toolkit for Conga Contract Intelligence with a real customer. I tested the AI against Prudential's own contracts and fed what I found back to Product and the AI team.

300documents validated
26data points checked
100+hours invested
  • Found limitations in the technology and shared them with Product, which led to improvements.
  • Gave the AI team real customer contract data to test against, something that hadn't been done before, as far as I know.
  • Wrote a planning guide for future Contract Intelligence POCs, plus an intake document for customers requesting one.
  • Recognized as a Q2 FY25 Conga Super Star for Entrepreneurial Spirit.

The Conga AI Engine, particularly the latest release, is remarkably accurate. In many cases the results were very close to those achieved with [the auditor's] human review.

Third-party auditor, on the POC results
